The Path to the Candle

Points earned now shape what comes at launch.

Phase I

The Gathering

Wallets connect, daily check-ins begin, and the first quests open. Every action here is being recorded toward the eventual airdrop snapshot.

Phase II

The Trials

New quest tiers unlock — engagement, referrals, community milestones. Streaks compound, and the standings start to separate the loyal from the curious.

Phase III

The Snapshot

A wallet snapshot is taken. Exact eligibility rules, SP thresholds, and allocation tiers will be published here and pinned on our socials in advance.

Phase IV

The Candle Is Lit

Token launch. Eligible Guardians claim their allocation. The Court's ledger closes on one chapter and opens the next.

⚠️

Your wallet, your rules: connecting only ever asks you to approve a read-only connection and sign one verification message — it will never ask for your seed phrase, private key, or request a token transfer. Never sign a transaction you don't understand, and always double-check you're on the official $SHGN domain before connecting.

X / Twitter Telegram Roadmap

$SHGN is a community meme token on Solana. Shogun Points (SP) are a community engagement tracker, not a security, a deposit, or a guarantee of any future token, airdrop, or financial return — allocation rules, if any, will be published before launch and may change. Only connect wallets you control, never share your seed phrase, and only participate with funds you can afford to lose.
